description: Goldman Sachs is a leading global financial institution that delivers a broad range of financial services to a large and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals, with a purpose to advance sustainable economic growth and financial opportunity, and a goal, reflected in its One Goldman Sachs initiative, to deliver the full range of its services and expertise to support its clients in a more accessible, comprehensive and efficient manner across businesses and product areas. Its businesses are supported by its Global Investment Research business, which as of December 2025 provided fundamental research on approximately 3,000 companies worldwide and approximately 50 national economies, as well as on industries, currencies and commodities.
